name: faq-accordion
title: FAQ Accordion (Native Disclosure)

structuralKnobs: which row starts expanded (showContent on a details block)

locked: block nesting: group(surface) > [group(header), 5x core/details > answer paragraph]
accordion rows are native core/details (HTML <details>/<summary>) — NO JavaScript, NO custom-HTML toggle
each row: the question is the details summary; the answer is one paragraph inside the details
headings are h2 (section) — never h1 (a hero, if present, owns the single h1); the question is a <summary>, not a heading
parameterizationRules: The accordion is the native core/details disclosure block: expand/collapse is browser-native, so it works with zero JavaScript and degrades gracefully. Never substitute a Custom HTML toggle — that is the disqualifying block and defeats the point.

Open exactly one row by default (showContent:true on the first details). Opening all of them defeats the scannability an FAQ accordion exists to provide; opening none hides the answer pattern from first-time readers.
notes: A five-row FAQ built on the native core/details disclosure block (HTML <details>/<summary>) — a real accordion with zero JavaScript and no Custom HTML. The question is each details' summary attribute; the answer is one paragraph inside. core/details is admitted to the allowlist for this pattern. Headings stay at h2; the questions are <summary> elements, not headings. No new attribute bounds needed — details carries no URL-valued attributes.
